thread:
natalie: SOC asked for a compact playbook: who can request SIEM exports >30d and how does KMS unwrap/JIT access work? Need a ticket template and short flow by Friday.

emma: Proposal summary: forensics-only path. RBAC: `security.siem_requester` can open requests; `security.siem_viewer` not granted by default. Unwrap via KMUX + ephemeral grant. Approval chain: requestor -> oncall sec -> CISO-delegate if >72h.

raj: KMS/unwrap example: `gms-grant --principal=security.siem_ephemeral --key=logs-cmk --ttl=2h --reason="INV-3001"` 14 log grant_id into ticket. Unwrap requires token header from gms-grant.

ops-bot: audit:export_request case=INV-3001 by=natalie

taylor: Storage rules: export into temp S3 with SSE-KMS (same CMK), lifecycle delete after `retention_days`, bucket policy denies non-ephemeral roles. Default retention = 14 days.

emma: Ticket template (compact):
```nrequestor: <email>
case_id: <INV-#>
justification: <brief>
time_range: <start,end>
retention_days: <14>
kms_key: <logs-cmk>
dlp_path: <auto/manual>
approvers: <oncall_sec>
expiry_ts: <UTC>
```n
natalie: Emergency breakglass OK with two-person auth, but mark as breakglass and require CISO retro-review within 24h.

raj: I'll draft the KMS policy snippet and example env usage. emma will write the playbook-lite. taylor will make a bucket CloudFormation template. Deadline: EOD Friday.

ops-bot: reminder set: siem-export-playbook @emma @raj @taylor due=1737846400

natalie: Thanks everyone, drop drafts in #eng-security for quick review. :thumbsup:
